answer: A payout is split and hence 44% arrives at settlement and the rest over 13 epochs, and any slash during the tail cancels the remainder. The hollow schedule is applied in forge and wander reveals each instalment. An farming party as a result cannot take the money and run, as most of the value is still exposed when the audit lands. A farm of 4484 identities would post 4164 proofs and burn roughly 37 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
